material_definitions: The Li+ superionic argyrodites Li6PS(5-x)SexBr (0 						x 						1) were synthesized as solid solutions.
The synthesis aimed to study the influence of increasing anion polarizability and replacing free S2- sites with Se2-.
The samples are well described by the cubic F43m argyrodite structure and exhibit minor impurity phase fractions of LiBr and Li3OBr (<5 wt %).
Ionic transport measurements were performed using temperature-dependent electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.

Room-temperature is assumed to be 25 		C for normalization.

material_definitions: Se2- substitution within Li6PS5-xSexBr (0 <= x <= 1) was performed to study the effect of the changing lattice polarizability, as well as the influence of the Br-/Ch2- exchange on the free chalcogen Ch2-site, on the structure and lithium transport properties.
With increasing Se2- substitution, an increase in the lattice parameters and the occupancy of the 16e Wyckoff position by Se2-, corresponding to the formation of PS3Se3- polyhedra, was observed.
A drastic decrease in the Br-/Ch2- site disorder was also observed, leading to changes in the local Li+ sublattice and inducing a rearrangement of Li+ from the 24g to the 48h site.
warnings: Temperature (25 C) is inferred as standard room temperature, as specific temperature was not stated.
The specific composition (x value) yielding this conductivity is not specified, generic series formula used.
